proposals.expected_signal: Improves top-10 ranking by stabilizing sparse-user/item representations through two stochastic graph views and a contrastive auxiliary, with gains most likely coming from stronger tail-item separation
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive alignment may over-regularize embeddings and wash out ranking-specific structure, yielding flat or slightly worse NDCG@10 despite cleaner representation geometry
proposals.hypothesis: Given the weak but valid baseline signal, the next useful lineage step is not parameter tuning but adding self-supervised pressure to LightGCN-style propagation: uniform edge/node dropout views plus contrastive agreement should reduce oversmoothing and popularity collapse while preserving the pairwise ranking target
